## General Conference 2026: Registration opens on March 18th!

::: section

![](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/assets/icons/roundel.png){.newsimg width="180"}

We are very much looking forward to our section **Political Communication Between Disruptive Technologies and Democratic Backsliding** at the General Conference in Krakow, 8-11 September 2026.

Our wonderful section chairs **Johanna Burger** and **Thomas Milic** have been busy putting together an exciting program, and we are happy to share some preliminary numbers with you: We were able to accept 40 papers, organized in 10 panels, with an acceptance rate of 62.5%. 

Do not miss the **registration**, opening on **March 18** and closing on **April 30**! We hope to see many of you in Krakow in September!

<button class="readmore"><a href="https://ecpr.eu/GeneralConference">Register here!</a></button>

:::



## Next ECR Club Session on 10th March 2026 

::: section

![](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/assets/banners/ecr_club_sq.png){.newsimg width="180"}

::: section

Join our next **ECR Club** session, featuring **Edwin Jans** (**Wageningen University**) presenting *A drizzle, not a storm: Polarisation around climate change in dutch political and media debates*. The study employs a longitudinal manual content analysis (2010–2021) of parliamentary debates and newspapers to measure three forms of polarisation: ideological, affective, and factual belief. The findings show stable ideological divides, while affective and factual-belief polarisation remain low but show modest increases recently—trends linked in politics to the rise of ecological and populist radical-right parties and in media to popular newspapers.

The session will be chaired by **Mariken van der Velden** (**VU Amsterdam**), on **Tuesday 10 February 2026, 11:00–11:45 GMT**. 

<button class="readmore"><a href="https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/16972">Read more</a></button>

<button class="readmore"><a href="https://ecpr-eu.zoom.us/j/85212235856?pwd=xTw2V1AOaN7CvI9RbUOgT7gHgEfPAI.1">Zoom Link</a></button>



:::
